message.content:
Here is how to log in to OneDrive:

## Web Browser (Any Device)

1. Go to **https://onedrive.live.com** or **https://onedrive.com/sign-in**
2. Enter your **Microsoft account email address** or phone number
3. Click **Next**
4. Enter your **password**
5. Click **Sign in**

If you don't have a Microsoft account, click **"Create one"** to register for free.

---

## Windows 10/11 (Desktop App)

1. Click the **Start Menu** and search for **"OneDrive"**
2. Click the **OneDrive app** to open it
3. Enter your **Microsoft account email** and click **Sign in**
4. If prompted, enter your **password**
5. Review the Privacy Policy and click **Next**
6. Choose whether to send additional data to Microsoft, then click **Accept**
7. Confirm or change your OneDrive folder location, then click **Next**
8. Select folders to back up (or skip), then click **Start backup**
9. Click **Open My OneDrive Folder** when finished

> **Note:** If you're signed into Windows with the same Microsoft account, you may not need to enter a password again.

---

## Mac, iPhone, iPad, or Android

1. Download the **OneDrive app** from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android)
2. Open the **OneDrive app**
3. Tap **Sign in**
4. Enter your **Microsoft account email** and tap **Next**
5. Enter your **password** and tap **Sign in**

---

## Troubleshooting Login Issues

| Problem | Solution |
|---------|----------|
| Forgot password | Click **"Forgot password?"** on the sign-in page |
| Two-factor authentication issues | Check your email, text messages, or Microsoft Authenticator app for the verification code |
| Error 0x8004de85 or 0x8004de8a | Make sure you're using the correct account type (personal vs. work/school) |
| Error 0x8004de40 | Enable TLS 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 in Internet Options (`inetcpl.cpl` → Advanced tab) |
| App won't sign in | Try unlinking and re-linking: Right-click OneDrive icon → Settings → Account → **Unlink this PC** → Sign in again |
| Account frozen | Visit OneDrive.com and follow instructions to unfreeze |

---

**Prerequisites for signing in:**
- A **Microsoft account** (free to create)
- **Internet connection**
- Compatible device with updated software

Sources:
1. https://one-drive.helpshift.com/hc/faq/10-how-to-sign-in-to-onedrive-account/
2. https://www.xda-developers.com/how-to-sign-into-onedrive/
3. https://www.cu.edu/doc/how-log-onedrive-pcpdf-3

6. https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/sharepoint/troubleshoot/sync/error-0x8004de40-in-onedrive
7. https://www.feidaoboke.com/post/fix-onedrive-login-issue-error-code-0x8004de44.html
8. https://www.elevenforum.com/t/onedrive-suddenly-wont-log-in-and-sync.28940/
9. https://www.solveyourtech.com/how-to-change-onedrive-account-on-windows-11-a-step-by-step-guide-2/
